find: background: rgb(from Highlight r g b / 1);
replace: background: rgb(from Highlight r g b);
why: The forced-colours disc loses its explicit alpha. Relative colour syntax with the alpha omitted inherits the origin's, and Chromium's emulated Highlight carries 0.8 in both schemes -- measured: the value computed to `color(srgb 0 0.901961 1 / 0.8)`, the same translucent disc the owner reported on issue #630. The rule still names Highlight and still opts out of forcing, so only the `/ 1` distinguishes it. Killed by the guard that the forced disc carries the opaque form after its plain fallback.
killedBy: forced-colors conformance (issue #368) paints the selected check's disc OPAQUE, keeping plain Highlight only as the fallback
